title: spider-intelligence：开源本地优先AI助手项目
summary: 这是一个基于TypeScript的开源AI助手项目，主打本地优先与隐私保护，集成LLM、语音助手、多模态与AI编排等功能，定位类似Jarvis的个人智能体平台。
summary_en: An open-source, local-first and privacy-first AI assistant project built in TypeScript, integrating LLMs, voice assistance, multimodal AI and agent orchestration into a Jarvis-like personal AI platform.
